metric.name: Unity of invention / restriction and election practice
metric.text: Ensure claims are directed to a single general inventive concept; apply and respond to PCT unity and U.S. restriction/election (including election of species, linking/joinder, co‑pending/RCE interactions, and double‑patenting considerations).
